text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One useful method is to use SMART goals, which means goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. This framework helps teams stay focused and know exactly what they want to achieve. It is also important to break a project into milestones, which are key points along the way. These help you track progress and celebrate smaller successes. In addition, you should define clear deliverables, such as reports or products, so everyone knows what the final result should look like. Finally, stakeholder alignment matters because all the people involved need to agree on the goals from the start.
